title: 薄层色谱的操作与安全（国内版）
source_doc: course/Fume Hood & Cabinet Protocols/09_Performing Thin Layer Chromatography (TLC).md
author_source: project/Fume Hood & Cabinet Protocols/09_Performing Thin Layer Chromatography (TLC)（国内版）/src.py

points.K8: 标准品、混合物和未知样
points.K11: 标出均匀分开的点样位置
points.K24: 用途三：为柱色谱选溶剂
points.S5: 化学显色也在通风柜内
points.S6: 废液和废弃物分类收集

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，手里举着一块空白薄层板，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench, holds up a small blank white plate and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课学薄层色谱的操作与安全。
overlay: 薄层色谱的操作与安全

shots.scene: 薄层板、展开缸、紫外灯、通风柜四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a small white plate with dots, a capped glass jar, a lamp with violet rays, and a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 点得准、展得稳、看得清、做得安全。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一份空白反应记录，挠头看着烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank lab notebook and scratches his head while looking at a round-bottom flask.
shots.narration: 阿杰想知道：反应到底做成没有？

shots.scene: 阿杰在普通实验台上拧开一瓶溶剂，旁边有加热台
shots.prompt_en: The young male student opens a solvent bottle with a blank label on an open bench next to a hot plate.
shots.narration: 他在敞开的台面上就要配展开剂。

shots.scene: 敞开台面倒溶剂的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of solvent being poured on an open bench with vapor wisps rising, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 溶剂蒸气会飘满房间，还怕火。

shots.scene: 小研把阿杰引到通风柜前，指着拉下的柜门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leads the young male student to a fume hood and points at its lowered sash.
shots.narration: 小研说：走，到通风柜里做。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 先学原理和步骤，再看安全要点。

shots.scene: 三个图标：分液漏斗、蒸馏烧瓶、色谱板
shots.prompt_en: Three icons side by side: a separatory funnel, a distillation flask and a small plate with colored dots. No people.
shots.narration: 萃取靠溶解度，蒸馏靠沸点。

shots.scene: 色谱板上不同颜色的斑点分开排列
shots.prompt_en: A white plate with colored spots separating into different heights. No people.
shots.narration: 色谱，则是按极性的差别来分离。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一块放大的薄层板图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a large icon of a thin white plate with a pencil line near the bottom.
shots.narration: 薄层色谱，简称TLC。

shots.scene: 板的剖面：底板上覆一层细小颗粒
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of a plate: a thin layer of fine white powder coated on a backing sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 板上涂着薄薄一层吸附剂。

shots.scene: 几个斑点在同一种溶剂中走出不同高度
shots.prompt_en: Several spots on a plate travel to different heights as liquid rises up the plate. No people.
shots.narration: 比较各组分在溶剂里走多远，来分离。

shots.scene: 不挥发的样品瓶图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a capped sample vial with a green check mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 它适合分析不易挥发的样品。

shots.scene: 小研在空白屏幕前讲原理，阿杰记笔记
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student explains in front of a blank screen while the young male student takes notes.
shots.narration: 原理课要先学，这里重点讲动手。

shots.scene: 烧杯里立着一块板，底部有一层液体，两个箭头分别指向板和液体
shots.prompt_en: A beaker with a plate standing in a shallow layer of liquid; one arrow points to the plate, another to the liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 色谱都有流动相和固定相。

shots.scene: 液体沿板上行，带着斑点移动
shots.prompt_en: Liquid creeps up the plate and carries colored spots upward with it. No people.
shots.narration: 展开剂是流动相，沿板向上走。

shots.scene: 板上吸附层被高亮
shots.prompt_en: The white coating layer of the plate is highlighted with a soft glow. No people.
shots.narration: 板上的吸附层，就是固定相。

shots.scene: 大小不同的几块空白薄层板
shots.prompt_en: Several blank white plates of different widths laid side by side on a dark bench. No people.
shots.narration: 先准备薄层板，样品多就选宽一些。

shots.scene: 小研在通风柜内拿起一瓶空白标签的溶剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: Inside a fume hood, the female graduate student in goggles, lab coat and gloves picks up a solvent bottle with a blank label.
shots.narration: 展开剂要按待分离的物质来选。

shots.scene: 两个溶剂瓶图标按比例混合
shots.prompt_en: Two solvent bottle icons pouring into one bottle with a ratio symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 示例用乙酸乙酯加少量乙酸。

shots.scene: 极性旋钮图标，指针左右调节
shots.prompt_en: A dial icon labeled with plus and minus signs, its needle turning left and right. No people.
shots.narration: 分不开，就调整展开剂的极性。

shots.scene: 带盖玻璃广口瓶
shots.prompt_en: A clean glass jar with a screw cap on a dark bench. No people.
shots.narration: 再找一个能盖严的玻璃容器当展开缸。

shots.section_title: 标准品、混合物和未知样
shots.scene: 四个样品瓶排成一行，分别标图示文字
shots.prompt_en: Four small capped sample vials in a row with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 样品有四个：两个标准品、混合物和未知样。
overlay: 标准品、混合物和未知样

shots.section_title: 标准品、混合物和未知样
shots.scene: 未知样瓶子旁浮现问号，分别连到A和B
shots.prompt_en: A question mark floats above one vial, with dashed lines linking it to two other vials. No people.
shots.narration: 未知样是A还是B，还是两者都有？

shots.section_title: 标准品、混合物和未知样
shots.scene: 放大镜图标下的样品瓶
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass icon over a sample vial. No people.
shots.narration: 这就是TLC的一大用途：鉴定物质。

shots.scene: 镊子、铅笔、直尺、毛细管四个物品摆在台面上
shots.prompt_en: A pair of tweezers, a pencil, a ruler and a box of thin glass capillary tubes laid out on a dark bench. No people.
shots.narration: 还要镊子、铅笔、直尺和毛细管。

shots.scene: 小研用铅笔和直尺在板底轻轻画线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles and gloves gently draws a line near the bottom of a white plate with a pencil and ruler.
shots.narration: 用铅笔在板底约一厘米处画起始线。

shots.scene: 起始线过低，被液面淹没的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a plate whose bottom line sits below the liquid level, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 线太低，样品会被溶剂直接冲走。

shots.scene: 铅笔用力刮破涂层的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a pencil pressing hard and scratching the white coating, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 下笔要轻，别刮破薄薄的涂层。

shots.section_title: 标出均匀分开的点样位置
shots.scene: 起始线上四个均匀间隔的小点
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a white plate with four evenly spaced small dots on the bottom line. No people.
shots.narration: 在线上标出四个点，间距均匀。
overlay: 标出均匀分开的点样位置

shots.section_title: 标出均匀分开的点样位置
shots.scene: 点与点之间的间距用双箭头表示
shots.prompt_en: Double arrows show equal gaps between the dots on the plate. No people.
shots.narration: 点要分得够开，各自标好记号。

shots.scene: 毛细管伸进样品瓶，液体自动上升
shots.prompt_en: A thin glass capillary tube dips into a sample vial and liquid rises inside it by itself. No people.
shots.narration: 毛细管蘸一下，液体会自己吸上来。

shots.scene: 毛细管尖轻触板上的点
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand lightly touches the tip of a capillary tube onto a dot on the white plate.
shots.narration: 在对应的点上轻轻一碰。

shots.scene: 三次轻触的图标，斑点小而圆
shots.prompt_en: An icon showing three light taps and a small round spot on the plate. No people.
shots.narration: 轻触几次，斑点越小分得越清。

shots.scene: 四根毛细管各对应一个样品瓶
shots.prompt_en: Four capillary tubes, each paired with its own sample vial by a matching color line. No people.
shots.narration: 换一个样品，就换一根毛细管。

shots.scene: 两个斑点连成一片的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two spots bleeding into each other on the plate, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 斑点不能连在一起，否则结果难读。

shots.scene: 小研在通风柜内向广口瓶加入少量展开剂
shots.prompt_en: Inside a fume hood, the female graduate student in goggles and gloves adds a small amount of solvent into a glass jar with a dropper.
shots.narration: 展开缸里只加浅浅一层展开剂。

shots.scene: 盖上盖子的展开缸，旁边有沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: A capped glass jar with a thin layer of liquid at the bottom, an hourglass icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 盖上盖子，静置几分钟。

shots.scene: 镊子夹着板放入展开缸
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand uses tweezers to lower the white plate gently into the glass jar inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 用镊子夹板，轻轻放进展开缸。

shots.scene: 液面与起始线对比图：液面在线下方打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: liquid level below the pencil line with a green check, and liquid above the line crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 液面一定要低于起始线。

shots.scene: 展开缸盖上盖子
shots.prompt_en: A hand screws the cap onto the jar with the plate standing inside.
shots.narration: 放好后马上盖盖，静静等待。

shots.scene: 展开缸里液体沿板上升，斑点分开
shots.prompt_en: Inside a capped jar, liquid climbs up the plate and the spots begin to separate. No people.
shots.narration: 展开剂往上爬，带着样品一起走。

shots.scene: 小球快速前进，另一个小球被小钩子拉住
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a smooth ball racing ahead on a track while another ball is held back by small hooks on the track. No people.
shots.narration: 非极性物质跑得快。

shots.scene: 极性分子与表面羟基相互吸引的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a polar molecule icon attracted to small hook-shaped groups on a surface. No people.
shots.narration: 极性物质被吸附层拉住，跑得慢。

shots.scene: 小研盯着展开缸，前沿接近顶部
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student watches the jar as the liquid front nears the top of the plate.
shots.narration: 盯住展开缸，别让前沿跑到顶。

shots.scene: 镊子取出薄层板
shots.prompt_en: Tweezers lift the plate out of the opened jar inside a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 前沿离顶部还差一点，就取出来。

shots.scene: 铅笔沿湿润的前沿画线
shots.prompt_en: A pencil quickly draws a line along the damp liquid front on the plate. No people.
shots.narration: 趁没干，马上画出溶剂前沿。

shots.scene: 板放在通风柜内晾干
shots.prompt_en: The plate rests on a clean tile inside a fume hood to dry. No people.
shots.narration: 然后让整块板彻底晾干。

shots.scene: 肉眼看空白的板，问号
shots.prompt_en: A plain white plate with no visible spots and a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 有色物质能直接看，多数却看不见。

shots.scene: 封闭式紫外观察箱里，板发出绿色荧光，显出暗斑
shots.prompt_en: A closed viewing cabinet with violet light inside; the plate glows green with dark spots. No people.
shots.narration: 放到紫外灯下，斑点就显出来了。

shots.scene: 铅笔把斑点圈出来
shots.prompt_en: A pencil draws circles around the spots on the plate. No people.
shots.narration: 用铅笔把每个斑点圈出来。

shots.scene: 紫外线照向眼睛的图标，带警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An icon of violet rays shining toward an eye, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 紫外线会伤眼睛。

shots.scene: 小研戴着防紫外护目镜操作紫外灯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing UV protective goggles holds a handheld lamp pointed down at a plate.
shots.narration: 没有封闭观察箱，一定要戴防护眼镜。

shots.scene: 圈好斑点的板，四列斑点
shots.prompt_en: A plate with four columns of circled spots: two single spots at different heights, one column with both, and one matching the higher spot. No people.
shots.narration: 来读结果：B比A走得远。

shots.scene: A+B那一列出现两个斑点
shots.prompt_en: The mixed column on the plate shows two circled spots, highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 混合样正好出现两个斑点。

shots.scene: 未知样斑点与B连线打勾
shots.prompt_en: A dashed line links the unknown column spot to the B spot at the same height, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 未知样和B一致，就是阿司匹林。

shots.scene: A斑点旁出现极性符号
shots.prompt_en: The lower spot is highlighted with a small polarity symbol beside it. No people.
shots.narration: A走得近，说明A的极性更大。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着板上的两个距离箭头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a plate diagram with two arrows: a short one to a spot and a long one to the top line.
shots.narration: 还能算出比移值，简称Rf。

shots.scene: 直尺测量起始线到斑点中心
shots.prompt_en: A ruler measures from the bottom pencil line to the center of a spot. No people.
shots.narration: 量起始线到斑点中心的距离。

shots.scene: 直尺测量起始线到前沿线
shots.prompt_en: A ruler measures from the bottom pencil line to the top front line. No people.
shots.narration: 再量起始线到前沿线的距离。

shots.scene: 计算器图标，结果小于1
shots.prompt_en: A calculator icon showing a fraction smaller than one. No people.
shots.narration: 两者相除，Rf总是小于一。

shots.scene: 数值与一本空白手册中的表格对照
shots.prompt_en: A number card compared with a table in a blank reference book. No people.
shots.narration: 和文献数据比对，确认物质身份。

shots.scene: 烧瓶和一块板，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A flask icon next to a plate with a single spot and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: TLC又快又方便，能确认产物。

shots.scene: 加热搅拌台上的烧瓶，旁边三块板依次排开
shots.prompt_en: A flask on a stirring plate beside three plates in a row showing a spot fading and a new spot appearing. No people.
shots.narration: 反应中途取样点板，可以追踪进度。

shots.scene: 原料斑点消失，打勾
shots.prompt_en: On the last plate the starting spot has disappeared, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 原料斑点没了，反应就完成了。

shots.section_title: 用途三：为柱色谱选溶剂
shots.scene: 几块用不同展开剂跑的板，最好的一块打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three plates run with different solvents; the one with the best-separated spots gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 多试几种展开剂，挑分得最好的。
overlay: 用途三：为柱色谱选溶剂

shots.section_title: 用途三：为柱色谱选溶剂
shots.scene: 玻璃色谱柱中分成色带
shots.prompt_en: A glass chromatography column with colored bands separating as liquid flows down. No people.
shots.narration: 再用到柱色谱里，大量分离样品。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在通风柜旁，柜门半拉下
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a fume hood with its sash partly lowered.
shots.narration: 展开剂易挥发，操作放进通风柜。

shots.scene: 配液、加液、取板、晾干四个图标都在通风柜框内
shots.prompt_en: Four icons inside a fume hood outline: mixing solvent, filling a jar, lifting a plate and drying a plate. No people.
shots.narration: 配液、放板、取板、晾干都在柜内。

shots.scene: 柜门高度标线，手在柜门下操作
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood sash lowered to a marked line; gloved hands work below it, the face stays behind the glass.
shots.narration: 柜门拉到规定高度，头别伸进去。

shots.scene: 通风柜里堆满杂物的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fume hood crammed with bottles and boxes, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 柜内别堆杂物，以免挡住气流。

shots.scene: 易燃液体标志旁的溶剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: A flammable liquid warning sign beside a solvent bottle with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 乙酸乙酯等溶剂易燃。

shots.scene: 酒精灯和电热板靠近溶剂瓶，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an alcohol burner and a hot plate next to a solvent bottle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 旁边不能有明火和热源。

shots.scene: 小瓶取用，大瓶盖好放回柜中
shots.prompt_en: A small dropper bottle on the bench while the large capped solvent bottle goes back into a cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 用多少取多少，用完立即盖好。

shots.scene: 小研展示护目镜、实验服、手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shows her safety goggles, buttoned lab coat and nitrile gloves.
shots.narration: 护目镜、实验服、手套都要穿戴好。

shots.scene: 普通眼镜图标打红叉，护目镜打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: ordinary glasses crossed out with a red X, and wraparound safety goggles with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 普通眼镜代替不了护目镜。

shots.scene: 沾了溶剂的手套被摘下，换上新手套
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand with a wet stain peels off the glove and puts on a fresh one. No people.
shots.narration: 手套沾了溶剂，及时更换。

shots.scene: 紫外灯直视的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an eye looking straight into a violet lamp, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要直视紫外灯管。

shots.scene: 封闭观察箱打勾，手不伸进光下
shots.prompt_en: A closed viewing cabinet with a green check; hands stay outside the violet light. No people.
shots.narration: 优先用封闭观察箱，皮肤少受照射。

shots.scene: 用完关灯的图标
shots.prompt_en: A hand switches off the lamp, the violet rays disappear. No people.
shots.narration: 看完及时关灯。

shots.section_title: 化学显色也在通风柜内
shots.scene: 通风柜内一个盖好的玻璃缸
shots.prompt_en: A covered glass staining jar inside a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 有时还要用化学试剂显色。
overlay: 化学显色也在通风柜内

shots.section_title: 化学显色也在通风柜内
shots.scene: 腐蚀和有毒警示标志
shots.prompt_en: A corrosive warning sign and a toxic warning sign side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 显色剂多有毒或有腐蚀性。

shots.section_title: 化学显色也在通风柜内
shots.scene: 小研在通风柜内用镊子操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles and gloves handles a plate with tweezers inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 按老师给的规程，在通风柜内操作。

shots.section_title: 废液和废弃物分类收集
shots.scene: 用过的展开剂倒入有机废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Used solvent from the jar is poured through a funnel into a labeled waste container with a blank label inside a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的展开剂倒进有机废液桶。
overlay: 废液和废弃物分类收集

shots.section_title: 废液和废弃物分类收集
shots.scene: 水槽下水道图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of solvent poured into a sink drain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能倒进下水道。

shots.section_title: 废液和废弃物分类收集
shots.scene: 毛细管放入碎玻璃收集盒
shots.prompt_en: Used glass capillary tubes go into a broken-glass collection box. No people.
shots.narration: 毛细管属玻璃废物，放进专用盒。

shots.section_title: 废液和废弃物分类收集
shots.scene: 废薄层板放入固体废物袋
shots.prompt_en: Used plates go into a solid chemical waste bag. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的板按固体化学废物收集。

shots.scene: 阿杰在洗眼器前冲洗眼睛，小研扶着他
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rinses his eyes at an eyewash station while the female graduate student supports him.
shots.narration: 溶剂溅进眼睛，立即用洗眼器冲洗。

shots.scene: 手臂在水龙头下冲洗
shots.prompt_en: A forearm is rinsed under running water at a lab sink. No people.
shots.narration: 溅到皮肤，脱去污染衣物，用水冲洗。

shots.scene: 小研用灭火毯盖住冒火的小烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student covers a small flaming beaker with a fire blanket.
shots.narration: 小火先断热源，用灭火毯盖灭。

shots.scene: 电话图标，119和120
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a fire icon and a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 火势大立即撤离，拨打119、120。

shots.scene: 小研向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man at the lab doorway; he listens and nods.
shots.narration: 事后都要报告实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现薄层板、毛细管、展开缸图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a plate, a capillary tube and a capped jar.
shots.narration: 铅笔画线，一样一管，斑点要小。

shots.scene: 液面低于起始线、盖盖的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a liquid level below the pencil line and a capped jar, both with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 液面低于起始线，放板后马上盖盖。

shots.scene: 前沿线、紫外灯、Rf公式图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a front line on a plate, a violet lamp and a simple fraction symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 画前沿、紫外显色、算出Rf。

shots.scene: 通风柜、护目镜、废液桶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fume hood, safety goggles and a waste container with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜里操作，戴好防护，废液回收。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的通风柜旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a clean, tidy fume hood with its sash lowered.
shots.narration: 小小一块板，安全不能少，下次见！
